name: FLUX.1 Schnell
tagline: Fast 12B-parameter rectified-flow image generation model delivering sharp prompts and clean typography in 1 to 4 steps.
real_test_summary: Tested the NF4 quantized checkpoint locally inside ComfyUI and Forge on an 8GB VRAM GPU. Renders crisp 1024x1024 images with accurate embedded text in 4 steps completely offline.
pros: Generates crisp 1024x1024 images in just 1 to 4 inference steps
Apache-2.0 license allows unrestricted commercial artwork and product use
Quantized GGUF and NF4 weights run smoothly on 8GB VRAM GPUs
cons: Full FP16 weights require 24GB+ VRAM without quantization
Less responsive to negative prompts than traditional SDXL pipelines
